about: Hand-kept source for What came first? (Bible Firsts). Built by scripts/build-what-came-first.ts into firsts.json; edit here, then rebuild.

questions.question: Who was the first man?
questions.why: Paul writes, 'The first man Adam became a living being,' recalling how the LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground (Genesis 2:7).

questions.question: Who was the first woman?
questions.why: Adam named his wife Eve 'because she would be the mother of all the living', and Paul writes, 'Adam was formed first, and then Eve.'

questions.question: Whose death is the first one the Bible tells?
questions.why: Genesis tells no death before Cain 'rose up against his brother Abel and killed him' (Genesis 4:8); Adam's death comes later, in Genesis 5:5.

questions.question: Who built the first city the Bible mentions?
questions.why: The first city in the Bible is the one in Genesis 4:17: 'Cain built a city and named it after his son Enoch.'

questions.question: After whose birth does Genesis say people began to call on the name of the LORD?
questions.why: 'To Seth also a son was born, and he called him Enosh. At that time men began to call upon the name of the LORD.'

questions.question: Who was the father of all who play the harp and flute?
questions.why: Genesis 4:21 says Jubal 'was the father of all who play the harp and flute'; his brother Jabal fathered tent-dwellers and Tubal-cain forged bronze and iron.

questions.question: Which bird did Noah send out first?
questions.why: Noah opened the window of the ark 'and sent out a raven'; only then did he send out a dove (Genesis 8:7-8).

questions.question: Who was Isaac's firstborn son?
questions.why: 'The first one came out red, covered with hair like a fur coat; so they named him Esau,' and Jacob came out after him, grasping his heel.

questions.question: Who was Jacob's firstborn son?
questions.why: Jacob told him, 'Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength' (Genesis 49:3).

questions.question: Whom did the LORD raise up as the first deliverer in the book of Judges?
questions.why: The first time Israel cried out in Judges, the LORD 'raised up Othniel son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz as a deliverer to save them'; Ehud came next (Judges 3:15).

questions.question: Who was Israel's first high priest?
questions.why: God called Aaron and his sons 'to serve Me as priests' (Exodus 28:1), and Hebrews says a high priest 'must be called by God, just as Aaron was'; Eleazar took his garments only when Aaron died.

questions.question: Who was the first king of Israel?
questions.why: When the people asked for a king, Samuel anointed Saul and all the people shouted, 'Long live the king!' (1 Samuel 10:24; Acts 13:21).

questions.question: When Solomon's kingdom split, who became the first king of the northern tribes?
questions.why: When Israel rebelled against the house of David, they summoned Jeroboam 'and made him king over all Israel' (1 Kings 12:20).

questions.question: When Solomon's kingdom split, who was Judah's first king?
questions.why: After the split, 'Rehoboam still reigned over the Israelites living in the cities of Judah' (1 Kings 12:17); Rehoboam son of Solomon reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem.

questions.question: Who was King David's firstborn son?
questions.why: Of the sons born to David in Hebron, 'His firstborn was Amnon'; Absalom was the third and Adonijah the fourth (2 Samuel 3:2-4).

questions.question: What does John call the first of Jesus's signs?
questions.why: After the water was turned into wine, John writes, 'Jesus performed this, the first of His signs, at Cana in Galilee'; the official's son was 'the second sign' (John 4:54).

questions.question: Whom did Andrew first find and tell about Jesus?
questions.why: Andrew 'first found his brother Simon and told him, "We have found the Messiah"', and brought him to Jesus (John 1:41-42).

questions.question: Which apostle does Matthew name first in his list of the Twelve?
questions.why: 'These are the names of the twelve apostles: first Simon, called Peter, and his brother Andrew' (Matthew 10:2).

questions.question: When Peter and the disciple whom Jesus loved ran to the tomb, who got there first?
questions.why: 'The two were running together, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first' (John 20:4); Mary Magdalene had been there before them both (John 20:1).

questions.question: Which did Jesus call the first and greatest commandment?
never: You shall have no other gods
questions.why: Jesus said, 'Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind. This is the first and greatest commandment,' and loving your neighbor is the second.

questions.question: Which does Paul call the first commandment with a promise?
never: You shall not make an idol
questions.why: Paul writes, 'Honor your father and mother (which is the first commandment with a promise), that it may go well with you and that you may have a long life on the earth.'

questions.question: Where were the disciples first called Christians?
questions.why: 'The disciples were first called Christians at Antioch' (Acts 11:26).

questions.question: At the Jerusalem council, James said God had first visited the Gentiles. In whose house?
questions.why: James said, 'Simon has told us how God first visited the Gentiles,' recalling how Peter preached in Cornelius's house and the Holy Spirit fell on the Gentiles there (Acts 10:44-48).

questions.question: Whose baptism in Philippi does Acts tell first?
questions.why: In Philippi, Acts first tells how Lydia 'and her household had been baptized' (Acts 16:15); the jailer and his household were baptized later that same chapter (16:33).

questions.question: Who was the first Christian martyr?
questions.why: Stephen was stoned while he prayed, 'Lord Jesus, receive my spirit' (Acts 7:59–60), and Paul later spoke of the day 'the blood of Your witness Stephen was shed' (22:20). James the brother of John was put to death only later (Acts 12:2).

questions.question: What are the first words of the Bible?
never: In the beginning was the Word
questions.why: The Bible opens, 'In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth' (Genesis 1:1). John's gospel opens the same way, but it is not the Bible's first verse.

questions.question: Who was Adam and Eve's first son?
questions.why: Eve 'gave birth to Cain', and 'later she gave birth to Cain's brother Abel' (Genesis 4:1–2); Seth was born after Abel's death (4:25).

questions.question: Who was Abraham's first son?
questions.why: Abram had no child of his own (Genesis 15:3) until Hagar bore Ishmael when he was eighty-six (16:15–16); Isaac was born when he was a hundred (21:5).

questions.question: Who was Judah's firstborn?
questions.why: 'The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah ... Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD' (1 Chronicles 2:3; Genesis 38:6–7).

questions.question: One of Judah's twin sons put out his hand first and got the scarlet thread. Which twin was born first?
questions.why: The midwife tied a scarlet thread on the hand that came out, but that twin pulled it back and his brother came out: 'You have broken out first!' So he was named Perez; Zerah, with the thread, came after (Genesis 38:28–30).

questions.question: Who was Joseph's firstborn?
questions.why: 'Joseph named the firstborn Manasseh' (Genesis 41:51); Jacob crossed his hands to bless Ephraim, the younger, 'although Manasseh was the firstborn' (48:14).

questions.question: Who was Aaron's firstborn?
questions.why: 'These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, then Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar' (Numbers 3:2).

questions.question: Who was Jesse's firstborn?
questions.why: 'Jesse was the father of Eliab his firstborn' (1 Chronicles 2:13); when Israel faced Goliath, 'the firstborn was Eliab', 'and David was the youngest' (1 Samuel 17:13–14).

questions.question: Whom does Luke call Mary's firstborn son?
questions.why: 'She gave birth to her firstborn, a Son. She wrapped Him in swaddling cloths and laid Him in a manger' (Luke 2:7). James and Joses are named among Jesus's brothers (Mark 6:3).

questions.question: Which tribe did God take in place of Israel's firstborn?
questions.why: 'I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel in place of every firstborn Israelite from the womb' (Numbers 3:12; again in 3:45).

questions.question: Who asked the first question in the Bible?
questions.why: Genesis 1 and 2 hold no question; the first is the serpent's to the woman: 'Did God really say, "You must not eat from any tree in the garden?"' (Genesis 3:1).

questions.question: What was God's first question to Adam after he ate?
options: Who told you that you were naked?
What is this you have done?
questions.why: After they ate, 'the LORD God called out to the man, "Where are you?"' (Genesis 3:9); 'Who told you that you were naked?' came after (3:11).

questions.question: Who ate the forbidden fruit first?
questions.match: she took the fruit and ate it
questions.why: The woman 'took the fruit and ate it. She also gave some to her husband who was with her, and he ate it' (Genesis 3:6).

questions.question: Whom did Jacob marry first?
questions.why: Laban gave Jacob Leah first: 'It is not our custom here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older.' Rachel was given to him after the week's celebration (Genesis 29:23–28).

questions.question: What was the first sign God gave Moses at the burning bush?
questions.why: Moses threw his staff on the ground 'and it became a snake' (Exodus 4:3). Then came his leprous hand, and the LORD spoke of 'the first sign' and 'the second' (4:6–8); water turning to blood was a third (4:9).

questions.question: Which month did God make the first month of Israel's year?
options: The month of the Feast of Tabernacles
The month of the Day of Atonement
questions.match: the first month of your year
questions.why: Giving the first Passover, the LORD said, 'This month is the beginning of months for you; it shall be the first month of your year' (Exodus 12:2, 11); Israel left Egypt 'in the month of Abib' (13:4).

questions.question: Where did Israel first camp after crossing the Jordan?
questions.why: 'On the tenth day of the first month the people went up from the Jordan and camped at Gilgal on the eastern border of Jericho' (Joshua 4:19).

questions.question: Which city did Israel conquer first in Canaan?
questions.why: Israel's first city taken in Canaan was Jericho: the wall collapsed 'and all the people charged straight into the city and captured it' (Joshua 6:20). Ai fell after (Joshua 7–8).

questions.question: On Gideon's first night with the fleece, what happened?
questions.answer: The fleece was wet and the ground dry
options: The fleece was dry and the ground wet
questions.why: Gideon asked for dew only on the fleece with all the ground dry, 'and that is what happened'; the next night he asked for the reverse (Judges 6:37–40).

questions.question: What was the devil's first temptation of Jesus?
options: To throw himself down from the temple
To bow down and worship him
questions.why: In both Matthew and Luke the tempter first says, 'If You are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread' (Matthew 4:3; Luke 4:3). The two gospels give the other temptations in different orders.

questions.question: In the story of Jesus's life, what are the first words the Bible records Him saying?
questions.answer: Why were you looking for Me? Did you not know that I had to be in My Father's house?
options: Man shall not live on bread alone
Let it be so now (at His baptism)
questions.why: The first words of Jesus any gospel records come when He was twelve, in the temple (Luke 2:42, 49). His words at His baptism and in the wilderness came when He was about thirty (Luke 3:23).

questions.question: Two of John the Baptist's disciples first followed Jesus. Which one does John name?
questions.why: When the two disciples heard John, 'they followed Jesus'; 'Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, was one of the two', and he then found his brother Simon (John 1:37, 40–41). The other is not named.

questions.question: When Peter and the other disciple ran to the tomb, which of them went inside first?
questions.why: The other disciple reached the tomb first but did not go in; 'Simon Peter arrived just after him. He entered the tomb', and only then did the other disciple go in (John 20:5–8).

questions.question: On which day of the week did Jesus rise?
questions.answer: The first day of the week
questions.why: 'Early on the first day of the week' Mary Magdalene found the stone removed (John 20:1); Matthew and Mark also put the empty tomb 'on the first day of the week', where the women heard, 'He has risen!' (Matthew 28:1; Mark 16:2, 6).

questions.question: What did Jesus say to seek first?
questions.answer: The kingdom of God and His righteousness
questions.match: seek first the kingdom of God
questions.why: 'But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you' (Matthew 6:33).

questions.question: Before taking the speck out of your brother's eye, what must you first take out?
questions.answer: The beam (log) in your own eye
options: The speck in your own eye
questions.match: First take the beam out of your own eye
questions.why: 'You hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother's eye' (Matthew 7:5).

questions.question: Before offering your gift at the altar, what did Jesus say to do first?
questions.match: First go and be reconciled to your brother
questions.why: 'Leave your gift there before the altar. First go and be reconciled to your brother; then come and offer your gift' (Matthew 5:24).

questions.question: How does John finish the words "We love because..."?
questions.why: 'We love because He first loved us' (1 John 4:19).

questions.question: The gospel is the power of God for salvation, first to whom?
questions.why: Paul calls the gospel 'the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, first to the Jew, then to the Greek' (Romans 1:16).

questions.question: When the Lord comes down from heaven, who will rise first?
questions.match: the dead in Christ will be the first to rise
questions.why: 'The Lord Himself will descend from heaven ... and the dead in Christ will be the first to rise. After that, we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them' (1 Thessalonians 4:16–17).

questions.question: Whom does Paul call "the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep"?
questions.match: firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep
questions.why: 'But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep' (1 Corinthians 15:20).

questions.question: In Revelation, who says "I am the First and the Last"?
questions.why: The one who tells John 'I am the First and the Last' goes on, 'I was dead, and behold, now I am alive forever' (Revelation 1:17–18); at the end He says it again and names Himself: 'I, Jesus' (22:13, 16).

questions.question: Which church in Revelation abandoned the love it had at first?
questions.why: To the church in Ephesus: 'I have this against you: You have abandoned your first love' (Revelation 2:1, 4).

questions.question: What is the first Beatitude?
questions.answer: Blessed are the poor in spirit
options: Blessed are the pure in heart
questions.match: Blessed are the poor in spirit
questions.why: Jesus's blessings in the Sermon on the Mount begin, 'Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven' (Matthew 5:3); 'Blessed are those who mourn' comes next.

questions.question: Which fruit of the Spirit does Paul name first?
questions.match: the fruit of the Spirit is love
questions.why: 'But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness' (Galatians 5:22).

questions.question: Which of the seven churches in Revelation is addressed first?
questions.why: John is told to send his scroll 'to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea' (Revelation 1:11), and the first letter begins, 'To the angel of the church in Ephesus write' (2:1).

leftOut.name: Who first saw the risen Jesus?
leftOut.reason: Mark 16:9 states it, but that verse is in Mark's longer ending, whose place in Mark is disputed, and the other gospels do not settle who saw him first.

leftOut.name: Who was the first prophet?
leftOut.reason: Abraham is the first person called a prophet (Genesis 20:7), but that is only the first mention, not a stated first.

leftOut.name: Who was the first mighty one on the earth? (Nimrod)
leftOut.reason: The Berean says Nimrod 'began to be a mighty one' (Genesis 10:8), with no 'first', and Genesis 6:4 names 'mighty men of old' before the Flood.

leftOut.name: Who was the first apostle to die?
leftOut.reason: Acts records only James's death among the apostles (Acts 12:2), and Judas Iscariot died before him (Matthew 27:5; Acts 1:18), so any answer rests on inference about who counts.

leftOut.name: Who planted the first vineyard? (Noah)
leftOut.reason: The Berean says only that Noah 'proceeded to plant a vineyard' (Genesis 9:20); there is no 'first', and it is only the first mention.

leftOut.name: What was made on each day of Creation?
leftOut.reason: The owner ruled out every question on the days of Creation.

leftOut.name: Which plague came first?
leftOut.reason: The owner ruled out every question on the order of the plagues.

leftOut.name: Which book of the Bible was written first?
leftOut.reason: The order of writing rests on scholarship, not on a verse, and the owner ruled it out.

leftOut.name: Which of Jesus's miracles came first?
leftOut.reason: The gospels do not give one order for his miracles, and the owner ruled it out; only John's 'first of His signs' (John 2:11) is asked.
